main_text.p: filij Nebat: Cūq; reguasset filius eius Elah duobus annis, rebellauit contra eum seruus eius Zamri dux medie partis Equitū, & irruens in domū, vbi erat bibens & temulentus, eupercussit, interfecit, & eius vice regnauit: tāde vero & ipse {*}Zamri, ab Amri Prin-cipe militię expugnatus, palatiū ingres-sus, seipsum vnà cū domo regia cōflam-mauit, & quod pessimum fuit, mortuus est in peccatis suis, quæ peccauerat, faciens malū coram Domino, & ambulans in via Ieroboam, & in peccato eius quo fecit peccare Israel. Ita illius oraculi veritas inconcus-sa æternum stabit. {i}Quicunque effuderit humanum sanguinem, multò magis regalem, per hominem fundetur sanguis illius.* Zamri interitus miserandus.i Gen.9.
main_text.head: CAP. X. De vindicta in Athaliam aliosque Regi-cidas.
main_text.p: POsthæc statu regni Israelitici fusque deque versō, & mutationibꝰ varijs lacerato {k}Athalia illud monstrū sui sexꝰ, omne seme regiū) excepto solū Ioas quę Ioida abscōderat) è medio tollit. T rāfacto autē 7.annorū circuitu, Ioida Pōti-k 4.Reg.11

page.notes: Doubtful or abbreviated readings: "Cūq;" read as Cum-que; "seme" and "sexꝰ" read with long s as plain s; "quæ" (scan: "qua") may be "qua"; "T rāfacto" printed with a gap, kept as printed. Catchword printed "fex", read as "sex" (long s). Left edge shows the neighbouring page and is excluded. The "i" and "*" marks are rendered as reference marks in braces; the "k" mark is set before "Athalia".
